title: Two-storey column with beams: first-order moments under vertical and lateral load

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.location: Example 9.5, case 2 (alpha = 0.01, P = 3978 kN), moment diagram for Eq. 8.1
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Plane (x-y) problem of the source modelled in 3D with the global Y axis vertical, so that the source's x, y and theta_z are the model's X, Y and rz. In-plane bending is about local z for every member (default orientation), hence the source's I is the section's Iz. a (0, 0), b (0, 6), c (0, 10), d (4, 6), e (4, 10) m. Column ab-bc: A = 2.5e4 mm^2, I = 6.36e8 mm^4; beams bd, ce (rigidly connected to the column): A = 1.76e4 mm^2, I = 8.61e8 mm^4; E = 200,000 MPa. a is pinned; d and e are on rollers that hold the vertical displacement only (as drawn in the source). Loads: P = 3978 kN downward at c, 0.01 P along +x at c and at b. First-order analysis. Targets: the first-order values of the source's moment diagram (figure labels, kN m): 477 in the column below b, 461 in beam bd at b, 175 at joint c (beam ce). The assignment of the labels to member ends follows from statics: base shear 2 x 39.78 kN x 6 m = 477 kN m; 461 + 175 = overturning moment / 1. Section properties the source does not give because they do not enter its plane model (Iy, J; A where stated) are placeholders that do not influence the targets.

targets.precisionNote: printed "477" x 1000 (unit conversion / common factor of the source); tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit; figure label (kNm)
targets.sign: the source's moment diagram gives magnitudes; sign by statics in the engine's convention: the lateral loads act along +X, the rollers at d and e react upward, so the beams sag at the column (positive Mz at their end i), and the column moment at b below the joint is -(base shear) x 6 m (negative Mz at end j of ab, local y = +X)
